definition: The Underworld's Book of Life and Death is the hub of the reincarnation system, yet it has been repeatedly tampered with or specially handled, exposing a 'loophole' mechanism through which karma can be intervened; every alteration corresponds to a karmic connection
core_principle: In the original text the register is by no means immutable; there are three kinds of tamperers: self-deletion (Wukong) / judges' private edits (Judge Cui) / King Yama's special grants (Liu Quan / Kou Hong) — embodying the hidden rule that 'karma outweighs the registers'

cases.identity: Handsome Monkey King of Flower-Fruit Mountain, a grassroots figure with no official establishment
cases.original_fate: Soul register no. 1350, allotted a lifespan of 342 years, to die a natural death
cases.actual_fate: Forcibly deleted his death record, crossing out his own and all monkey-kind names, escaping samsara, and extending his life until he became a Buddha after the pilgrimage
cases.modifier: Sun Wukong (self-deletion, forcible erasure of death record)
cases.cause: Seeking immortality; dissatisfied with his lifespan after returning from Daoist study, he crossed out his own name and those of the Flower-Fruit Mountain monkeys
cases.long_term_consequence: The monkey tribe also left the Underworld's jurisdiction; the register was permanently altered with no remedy

cases.identity: Taizong Emperor of the Great Tang
cases.original_fate: His lifespan ended in the 13th year of the Zhenguan era; he was fated to die while touring the Underworld
cases.actual_fate: Judge Cui privately changed 'Zhenguan 13' to 'Zhenguan 33,' extending his life by 20 years and returning his soul to the living
cases.modifier: Judge Cui (Underworld judge, internal staff, private alteration)
cases.cause: Wei Zheng, an old friend of Judge Cui, pleaded via dream; Li Shimin toured the Underworld and saw virtuous souls amassing merit
cases.long_term_consequence: Li Shimin returned to life and held the Land-and-Water Assembly, launching the pilgrimage project — the story's master inciting incident

cases.identity: Squire Kou of Diling County, Tongtai Prefecture, who fed ten thousand monks
cases.original_fate: His lifespan was not yet up; kicked to death by robbers, his soul returned to the Underworld
cases.actual_fate: King Yama granted his soul's return, extending his life by 12 years — one extra cycle for the Great Tang
cases.modifier: Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva / King Yama (special grant) + Wukong's intercession in the Underworld
cases.cause: Merit from feeding ten thousand monks; mistakenly killed by robbers, his wronged soul filed a complaint
cases.long_term_consequence: Squire Kou's soul returned — showing the Underworld has a special channel for 'good people' and karma can be earned

cases.identity: Liu Quan of Junzhou, who hanged himself after his wife Li Cuilian was suspected over a golden hairpin she gave to a monk
cases.original_fate: Entered the Underworld delivering melons on behalf of the dead; fated to die in the melon-delivery task
cases.actual_fate: King Yama investigated and found both spouses had immortal lifespans, granting both return to life; Li Cuilian was reborn by borrowing the corpse of Li Shimin's sister Li Yuying
cases.modifier: King Yama (special grant, after examining karma)
cases.cause: Merit for delivering melons; both deaths were wrongful, so King Yama specially granted a double return
cases.long_term_consequence: The couple reunited — showing the Underworld has a 'special soul-return' channel that is not systematized but handled case-by-case by karma

cases.identity: Dragon lord of the Jing River outside Chang'an, of the water-kind
cases.original_fate: Should not have died; fated to live out his natural years
cases.actual_fate: Defied the edict by altering the timing and amount of rain; executed by Wei Zheng in a dream at the Dragon-Slaying Terrace, his dragon head falling onto a Chang'an street
cases.cause: Bet with Yuan Shoucheng and violated the Jade Emperor's edict on rain timing and amount, breaking heavenly law
cases.data_volume_affected: 1 record (but triggered the Tang king's later Underworld tour)
cases.long_term_consequence: The Dragon King's ghost haunted Li Shimin, causing his Underworld tour — the second major inciting incident of the pilgrimage project

cases.identity: Ruler of Wuji, murdered in a well three years earlier
cases.original_fate: Should not have died; pushed into the Eight-Treasure Glass Well and wrongfully dead for three years
cases.actual_fate: Suffered three years at the bottom of the well; Wukong fetched a soul-returning elixir and used the well water to revive him, restoring him to the throne
cases.modifier: Sun Wukong (fetched the elixir) + Bajie (carried the body from the well) + Manjushri Bodhisattva (tacitly let the green-maned lion act)
cases.cause: Three years earlier the King of Wuji had drowned an incarnation of Manjushri for three days, incurring retribution in kind
cases.data_volume_affected: 1 record (three years at the well bottom)
cases.long_term_consequence: After returning to life he converted to Buddhism — revealing that wrongful retribution must be repaid 'in kind'

cases.identity: A goldfish in Guanyin's lotus pond who surfaced daily to hear sutras and became a spirit
cases.original_fate: Originally a bodhisattva's pet, outside the register of life and death and beyond the six realms
cases.actual_fate: Descended on his own to the Tongtian River, becoming King of Inspiration, demanding boy-and-girl sacrifices and devouring countless people over 9 years
cases.modifier: The Goldfish Spirit descended on its own (without Guanyin's instruction); Guanyin retrieved it back to the lotus pond
cases.cause: Enlightened by hearing sutras, became a spirit and descended, using sacrifice as a pretext to seize bodies and eat people
cases.data_volume_affected: 18 boys and girls of Chen Village over 9 years; fated to reincarnate by the register, but their bodies were seized and consumed
cases.long_term_consequence: Guanyin retrieved it with a basket, outside the reincarnation system — revealing 'immortal-and-Buddha retinues' hold extra-legal power

cases.identity: Marshal Tianpeng · General Curtain-Lifter (martial deities of the Heavenly Court)
cases.original_fate: Originally orthodox deities of the Heavenly Court, enjoying heavenly stipends and outside samsara
cases.actual_fate: Zhu Bajie, for flirting with Chang'e, was demoted and wrongly cast into a sow's womb; Sha Wujing, for shattering a glass goblet, was demoted and pierced by a flying sword once every seven days
cases.cause: Bajie, drunk at the Peach Banquet, flirted with Chang'e; Wujing accidentally shattered a glass goblet at the Peach Banquet
cases.data_volume_affected: 2 records (two deities demoted to the mortal world)
cases.long_term_consequence: The two became core members of the pilgrimage team — revealing demotion is an 'atonement + training' mechanism, not pure punishment

registry_stats.common_pattern: The register is not immutable; every tamperer has a corresponding 'karmic connection' — karma outweighs the registers
registry_stats.governance_gap: Only 1 of 8 cases (the Jing River Dragon King) was executed by the book; the other 7 were 'special cases' — an 87.5% Underworld governance gap rate

registry_insights: In the Underworld the register is a 'reference book,' not an 'absolute book'; karmic connections can take priority over the registers
Of the 8 cases only the 'Jing River Dragon King' was executed by the book; the rest were 'tampering/special cases' — showing karma ranks above the registers
Li Shimin's 20 extra years of life is the story's master inciting incident; without it there is no pilgrimage project
Wukong's forcible deletion of his death record is the first 'tampering,' foreshadowing the havoc in Heaven and marking the start of the Heavenly Court's governance collapse
The soul-returns of Kou Hong and Liu Quan reveal the Underworld's 'special channel for good people,' not pure by-the-book execution
The Goldfish Spirit case reveals 'immortal-and-Buddha retinues' hold extra-legal power and can bypass the register
